summary: Ricardo Valencia Sanchez, 46, and his son Jose Louis Valencia, 16, both of Aurora, drowned on Father's Day after their raft flipped and they were ejected into the low-head-dam hydraulic at the Southside Diversion Dam near City Park on the Arkansas River; a third raft passenger made it to shore; Pueblo firefighters and officers responded ~1:24 p.m. and attempted resuscitation, unsuccessful; both victims wore life jackets
location: Arkansas River at the Southside Diversion Dam near City Park, Pueblo
responding_agency: Pueblo Fire Department; Pueblo police; Pueblo County Coroner
notes: KEKB/KOOL story parent-opened this run (raft flipped, trapped in river hydraulic, fire crews ~1:30 p.m., life jackets worn); location pinned via the KRDO-transcribed American Whitewater/BYU accident-database entry (dispatch ~1:24 p.m. to 4 Reservoir Road area, 'under the low head dam near City Park') and CPR 2021-01-28 (Southside Diversion Dam 'site of multiple fatalities, including two out-of-town rafters last summer'). Zero Pueblo-dam-2020 rows before insertion.
